race_history.story: Hamlin starts from pole, penalized, sent to back lap 2, battles back, passes Bell on final lap
Hamlin wins back-to-back. Commanding victory by 11.11 seconds over Erik Jones. Bell wrecked in violent collision with Larson.
race_history.narrative: Jill emerges as momentum reader. Hamlin erases 129-point deficit. Machine searching for answers.

race_history.story: Hamlin completes three consecutive wins. 63rd career Cup win ties Kyle Busch all-time. Ties record for most consecutive wins.

jill.quote: Three in a row is luck. Hurricane breaks the streak.
jill.reasoning: Tried to pick psychology/probability angle - logic sound, execution wrong

race_history.narrative: Machine bounces back. Jill shows sophisticated reasoning (three-in-a-row psychology) but loses. Algorithm solid on oval + road.

race_history.track_type: Street Course (NEW - BRAND NEW, never raced in Cup Series)
race_history.story: CHAOS. Part-time driver. 13th career start. FIRST CUP WIN. Beats Tyler Reddick in final laps. SVG wrecked Stage 1, finished 38th DNF.

jill.reasoning: Legend. 6 of 7 road/street course wins. Defending champ.

mikey.quote: SVG wins by a mile or 2.

race_history.narrative: THE TURNING POINT. All three predictors wrong. Underdog (Corey Heim - NOBODY expected) wins. Favorites crash (SVG wrecked). Street course chaos > all analysis. Algorithm humbled. Veteran experience questioned. Momentum irrelevant.

lessons_learned.machine: New tracks = unpredictable. Algorithm blind spot. Need v3.1 update: consistency beats dominance on NEW tracks.
lessons_learned.jill: Even the smartest reads fail on unpredictable tracks. Logic ≠ Execution.
lessons_learned.mikey: '39 years in racing and I didn't see THAT.' Veteran experience doesn't protect against chaos.

race_history.story: SVG held off Chase Briscoe by 0.357s for the second straight year and swept the weekend. 8th career road-course win, ties Tony Stewart for 2nd all-time. Ty Gibbs swept both stages, finished 3rd; Larson 4th, Bell 5th.

machine.note: v3.1 shipped Larson pre-rebuild and missed. v3.2, rebuilt overnight from the same pre-race inputs, returns SVG (the winner); credited as the call.

mikey.quote: SVG wins by a mile or 2.

race_history.narrative: REDEMPTION + REBUILD. Mikey's stubborn SVG call (kept after the San Diego DNF) pays off. The Machine missed live with Larson (v3.1), then rebuilt to v3.2 overnight; the fixed model returns SVG. Honest framing: rebuilt from pre-race inputs, credited the call.
race_history.algorithm_event: v3.1 -> v3.2: proportional finish + widened skill spread fixed the knife-edge (a +3% form nudge moved ~77 pts under v3.1, ~5 under v3.2). Favorites now ~16% over a real chase pack. 25 tests green.

meta.key_moment: Week 18 Sonoma - the Machine rebuilt itself (v3.2) overnight and returned the winner it missed live
meta.current_narrative: Algorithm evolution v3.1 -> v3.2 after Sonoma. Mikey hot, Jill still leads. Next: Chicagoland (first intermediate for a road-built engine).
